name: Bukit Timah
summary: Tree canopy, school corridors, and family housing — the classic west-central expat belt.
body: Bukit Timah is less a single village and more a corridor of green, schools, and landed/condo pockets stretching toward Upper Bukit Timah and Sixth Avenue. Families shortlist it for proximity to international campuses and a calmer evening rhythm than Holland V or River Valley. You will drive or Grab more; walkability varies block by block. Nature Reserve trails and Botanic Gardens adjacency matter if weekends outdoors are non-negotiable.
housingMix: Landed, townhouses, and mid-to-large family condos.
commuteNotes: Downtown Line (Sixth Avenue, Tan Kah Kee); buses along Bukit Timah Road.
